notes.content: The game requires Ubuntu version 21.04 or higher to run.

notes.title: Mac port available now!
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are presenting Mac Wineskin port of the game.

All bugs was fixed, but if You still have problem with Mac port, please, report it on discussion forum.
Alt+Tab might produce undesired behavior on some systems, beware.

Thank You and have a good play! ːsteamhappyː
